English caption: Figure 2.26 From this mind map of disasters that occur and actions to take, we could focus on one action area that matches our interests, passions and skills. After selecting an area of interest, we could create another mind map focused on our area of interest to identify solution sets. Next, we could apply one of the frameworks listed in Table 2.3. From there we could create an action plan of actions needed to become more informed about the idea or solutions. As you can see, an action plan fits into multiple areas.
